newResearch.design: 12 bounded actual GL depth-tested scene variants per fixed native timestamp; omission targets only 01/21/25/27 genuine Blender nonroad group spans, while actual source game/road/B51/ball/input/physical solver retain draw order and identical physical state

measures.metric: For target group 27 at fixed source-camera tick, compare screen screenshots [other scene unchanged] vs [27 omitted], with real WebGL2 depth test. RGB per-channel max abs >25 ROI x0=0 y0=80 x1=1005 y1=705. Removing rock groups reveals underlying geometry, so changes are visual influence rather than exact surface pixel ownership.
measures.units: percentage points of ROI pixels changed, NOT an ART score

series.conclusion: Both 21/25 create big source-frame rock obstruction; removing them reveals large turquoise water but only modest extra group27 detail.
Group01 adds strong occlusion in this sightline; all 3 rock groups removed increases impact 3.70x but actual projected structure remains too weak to declare a hero.
Removing 25 reveals extra facility pixels, removing 01+21 does not improve group27 further. True existing source R8J wheel still dominates rightward sightline.

measures.nativePictures: K4CT_R18_TRUE_GL_DEPTH_ART_VETO_RESEARCH_ONLY artifact includes BASE, NO27, NO21_25, NO21_25_27, NO01_21_25, NO01_21_25_27 at each of 3 timestamps, all from same Chromium source-camera tick
measures.sourceVisualAssessment: Removing 21/25 does open water and sky but exposes generic columns, thin incomplete structures and flat water expanses. Geological faceting and functional architecture remain toy-like and not one cohesive large-scale industrial harbor.
measures.limits: No direct numeric GL depth-buffer readback; only original GL depth-tested image differences. No genuine hazard-specific B51 visibility certification, road-human fun validation, GPU FPS/SAT/CCD certification, artistic approval, or claim of pixel ownership.

criticalDecision.finding: Occlusion IS a factor but not the sole or dominant remaining failure. At best group27 is still <=1.64% altered pixels after 3 rock groups are hidden, and visual narrative is weak. Rock removal alone is not a viable R18 art pass.
